requirements_summary:
- Scale: 8M–20M SKUs to index; nightly updates plus delta streams during day.
- Latency: target p95 <100ms for search + rerank on product listing pages; sub-50ms for embeddings lookup cache.
- Throughput: baseline 150 QPS; seasonal spikes 4–8x (Black Friday + promo events).
- Cost-sensitivity: target variable cost <$0.005 per query end-to-end (embedding store + rerank).
- Models: prefer open embedding models or small hosted embedding endpoint; rerank use lightweight cross-encoders for top-50 only, fallback to cheaper bi-encoder rerank.
- Routing/fallback: must support regional fallback and pinning to cheaper model variant when capacity constrained.
- Compliance: require SOC 2, SSO/SAML, audit logs, optional EU residency for EU shoppers.
